entry.title: Arab Bank Switzerland opens Abu Dhabi office and names Valérie Noël CEO
entry.summary: Arab Bank Switzerland opens Abu Dhabi office and names Valérie Noël Chief Executive Officer 2 days ago ADGM / FSRA · Added Nov 5, 2026 · Licensing · CryptoTopic evidence: 「Arab Bank Switzerland ME Ltd, the regional entity of Swiss Private Bank Arab Bank Switzerland, has announced the start of its operations in ADGM, the international financial centre of Abu Dhabi, follo」 Arab Bank Switzerland ME Ltd, the regional entity of Swiss private bank Arab Bank Switzerland, has started operations in ADGM after receiving a Financial Services Permission from the FSRA. The entity will advise institutions, corporates, fintechs, family offices and high net worth clients on accessing, holding, managing and passing on digital assets within ADGM's regulatory framework. Valérie Noël has been appointed Chief Executive Officer.

entry.title: The Not-So-Fine Print: How the FCA Makes Consumer Contracts Fair
entry.summary: The not-so-fine print: making consumer contracts fair FCA · Nov 6, 2026 · Guidance · CryptoTopic evidence: 「A crypto firm agreed to stop charging excessive storage fees which, in some cases, could exceed £40,000 a year.」 The UK Financial Conduct Authority explains how it checks whether terms in financial consumer contracts are fair and transparent under the Consumer Rights Act 2015. It gives examples including a crypto firm that stopped excessive storage fees, an adviser that dropped a complaint-handling charge, and a travel insurer that clarified unclear delay terms. It sets out what firms should do, such as using plain language and reviewing contracts regularly.

entry.title: Consultation conclusions on tightening limits on misleading names used by unregulated entities
entry.summary: SFC concludes consultation on further restricting use of misleading names by unregulated entities to protect investors SFC · Nov 6, 2026 · Guidance · CryptoTopic evidence: 「a similar provision under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance (AMLO)」 The Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) of Hong Kong published the conclusions of its consultation on restricting unregulated entities from adopting names that may falsely suggest regulated status. Respondents broadly supported expanding the restricted titles list under the Securities and Futures Ordinance and adding a similar provision to the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance. The SFC agreed to a faster list-update mechanism and plans to introduce an amendment bill to the Legislative Council.

entry.title: ADGM publishes guidance on crypto mining as the region's first such guidance
entry.summary: ADGM Becomes the Region's First International Financial Centre to Publish Dedicated Crypto Mining Guidance 28 Oct 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Oct 28, 2026 · Guidance · CryptoTopic evidence: 「the Guidance treats crypto mining as a licensable commercial activity overseen by the RA and not a regulated financial service」 The Registration Authority of Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM) has published its Guidance on Crypto Mining Activities in and from ADGM. Issued under section 23 of the Commercial Licensing Regulations 2025, it treats crypto mining as a licensable commercial activity overseen by the RA rather than a regulated financial service. The guidance applies a technology-neutral approach covering Proof-of-Work, Proof-of-Stake and future consensus mechanisms.

entry.title: Animoca Brands gets ADGM regulator permission to manage collective investment funds
entry.summary: Animoca Brands secures Financial Services Permission from ADGM’s FSRA to Manage Collective Investment funds 02 Nov 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Nov 2, 2026 · Licensing · CryptoTopic evidence: 「Animoca Brands today announced that its subsidiary, Animoca Asset Management (AD) Limited (AAM), has received a Financial Services Permission (FSP) by the Financial Services Regulatory Authority (FSRA」 Animoca Brands announced that its subsidiary, Animoca Asset Management (AD) Limited (AAM), received a Financial Services Permission from the FSRA of ADGM. The permission authorizes it to manage collective investment funds in or from ADGM. The company says the permission extends its institutional capabilities and supports its expansion in the Middle East.

entry.title: Texas Stock Exchange rule change on commodity-based trust shares, with accelerated approval
entry.summary: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Texas Stock Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing, and Order Granting Accelerated Approval of, a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 17.111(d) (Commodity-Based Trust Shares) Federal Register · Nov 3, 2026 · Licensing · CryptoTopic evidence: 「permit up to 15% of the net asset value of the Trust’s holdings to consist of certain digital commodities and securities that do not otherwise satisfy the applicable eligibility criteria」 The SEC published notice of, and approved on an accelerated basis, a Texas Stock Exchange proposal to amend Rule 17.111(d) and adopt generic listing standards for Commodity-Based Trust Shares. Under the change, such shares can be listed under Rule 19b-4(e) without a separate filing for each product. The proposal permits up to 15% of a trust's net asset value to consist of certain digital commodities and allows actively managed shares, and the Commission waived the 30-day operative delay. entry.title: HKMA extends Project Ensemble pilot to 24/7 interbank settlement of tokenised deposits
entry.summary: HKMA advances Project Ensemble pilot phase to 24/7 settlement in tokenised Central Bank Money HKMA · Nov 2, 2026 · Guidance · CryptoTopic evidence: 「support the interbank settlement of tokenised deposit transactions in tokenised Central Bank Money (CeBM) on a 24/7 basis」 The HKMA announced that EnsembleTX, the pilot phase of Project Ensemble, now supports 24/7 interbank settlement of tokenised deposit transactions in tokenised Central Bank Money. Participating banks rose to 12 and industry pioneers to 20. The capability lets participants settle tokenised transactions beyond conventional operating hours.

entry.title: Speech by SFC Executive Director Elisa Ng: scaling tokenisation in Hong Kong's capital markets
entry.summary: New speech by Elisa Ng: Keynote at Hong Kong FinTech Week x StartmeupHK 2026 SFC · Nov 2, 2026 · Speech · CryptoTopic evidence: 「Tokenisation involves the use of blockchain-based tokens to represent ownership of assets.」 Elisa Ng, the SFC's Executive Director of Investment Products, gave a keynote at Hong Kong FinTech Week on 2 November 2026. She said Hong Kong has built the groundwork for tokenisation and now has 17 tokenised retail products. She highlighted secondary trading of tokenised money market funds and treasury management linking tokenised funds with digital money. She also introduced an "innovation pathway" to provide regulatory flexibility for controlled pilots. entry.title: HKMA announces new fintech initiatives on agentic finance, post-quantum cryptography, tokenised settlement and cross-border payments
entry.summary: Hong Kong FinTech Week 2026 HKMA · Nov 2, 2026 · Guidance · CryptoTopic evidence: 「The HKMA has also completed trial trades involving Recognised Dealers conducting secondary market transactions of tokenised Exchange Fund Bills, enabling them to enhance efficiency in secondary and re」 The HKMA co-organised the 11th Hong Kong FinTech Week 2026 with Invest Hong Kong on 2 November 2026. It announced initiatives including Project SAGE on agentic finance governance, a PQC Toolkit to help banks transition to post-quantum cryptography, 24/7 settlement of tokenised transactions under EnsembleTX, and a link between the Faster Payment System and UnionPay International for QR code payments.

entry.title: FSRA statement on the Binance security incident
entry.summary: FSRA Statement Regarding Security Incident Involving Binance ADGM / FSRA · Oct 30, 2026 · Guidance · CryptoTopic evidence: 「The FSRA is aware of the matter relating to Binance exchange on 30 October 2026, concerning a security incident involving unauthorised withdrawals of assets.」 The Financial Services Regulatory Authority (FSRA) of ADGM says it is aware of a security incident at the Binance exchange on 30 October 2026 involving unauthorised withdrawals of assets. The FSRA is working closely with Binance and monitoring the situation. Protecting client interests and supporting market integrity and orderly functioning are its key priorities.

entry.title: Two firms charged in $130 million fraud using false SEC filings to appear legitimate
entry.summary: Two Entities Charged in $130 Million Fraud Scheme That Used False SEC Filings to Boost Investor Confidence SEC · Oct 30, 2026 · Enforcement · CryptoTopic evidence: 「for crypto asset trading. In addition, BG Wealth claimed to be the world's largest hedge fund」 The SEC charged BG Wealth Sharing Ltd and DSJ Exchange Pty Ltd, two foreign-operated firms incorporated in Colorado, with fraud. They allegedly filed false Form ADV and Form D documents to appear licensed, then raised over $130 million from tens of thousands of retail investors through a purported wealth-sharing program tied to crypto trading signals. The complaint seeks permanent injunctions, disgorgement, and civil penalties. The archived text and attachments run to about 43,500 characters; the summary is based only on the first 12,000. entry.title: Regulator approves first secondary trading of tokenised public funds in Hong Kong
entry.summary: SFC approves first-ever secondary trading of tokenised public funds SFC · Oct 26, 2026 · Guidance · CryptoTopic evidence: 「The Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) has approved the world’s first secondary trading of tokenised public funds on an SFC-licensed virtual asset trading platform (VATP).」 The Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission has approved the world's first secondary trading of tokenised public funds on a licensed virtual asset trading platform. Two authorised tokenised money market funds can now be traded around the clock. The SFC's April 2026 circular set out requirements covering trading operations, fair pricing, liquidity provision and disclosure. entry.title: UK regulator secures halt to HTX's unlawful crypto promotions
entry.summary: FCA stops HTX's crypto promotions FCA · Oct 29, 2026 · Enforcement · CryptoTopic evidence: 「Crypto firms should be under no illusion: being based overseas does not put them beyond the reach of UK law.」 The FCA reached a High Court settlement with Huobi Global S.A., the company behind crypto exchange HTX (formerly Huobi). It has undertaken not to knowingly promote cryptoasset services to UK consumers in breach of section 21 of FSMA. HTX has exited the UK, with deposits and new sign-ups no longer possible. The settlement terms are confidential and involve no admission of liability.
